guide.title: Setup guide
guide.subtitle: Open the WeChat developer console on the right and follow these steps
guide.openConsole: Open the WeChat console on the right
guide.openConsoleTitle: Opens the WeChat developer console in the right pane, keeping this guide on the left
guide.step1: 1. Click the button above to open the WeChat developer console on the right, then click “Official Account” to enter your verified account.
guide.step2: 2. Get the AppID and AppSecret under “Development → Basic Configuration” on the right
guide.step3: 3. Run “Check WeChat IP allowlist”. If WeChat rejects the current egress IP, add the reported address under “Development → Basic Configuration → IP whitelist”.
guide.step4: 4. Make sure the account has completed WeChat verification; otherwise the draft box API is unavailable
